async function mapLimit(
	items: number[],
	width: number,
	operation: (item: number) => Promise<void>,
) {
	for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await Promise.all(items.slice(offset, offset + width).map(operation));
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await audit(items[offset]);
	}
}
